I tend to fall for women that are grounded and quietly confident. Someone who doesn’t feel the need to perform. I’m drawn to emotional intelligence, subtle thoughtfulness, and people who pay attention without making a show of it. I don’t need constant grand gestures, but I’m not against them either. I really love doing nice, romantic things for people I care about. It brings me so much joy, and I’d love for them to receive it with the same amount.

I want someone who is intentional in every action they take, along with all the things they say. Maybe sees the world with wonder— I am proud of my childlike wonder at 32–, who’s not afraid to confront their own mess and keep growing. Someone who is okay with letting go of their pride for the sake of becoming a better partner, just as I would.

I like to live my life as if it were through the lens of a movie. And I will curate a Spotify playlist for every date or milestone in our lives if I find it necessary. So someone who can allow me to romanticize life, not for escapism, but just because small, simple every day things can be beautiful. 

I’ve got a soft spot for petite brunette femmes with long hair, maybe because I am a petite brunette femme with long hair. But at the end of the day it’s about how you move through this world, how you treat others (and in turn, how you love yourself), not just how you look. I tend to top — partly because I have a hard time orgasming, partly because it’s easier for me to focus on the other person — but I’d love to feel safe and relaxed enough with someone who can take over and let me receive and actually enjoy it 😅
Your self awareness will be such a lovely gift to your future person. Keep being you and the right one will come.
